As players progress through the levels, they will encounter various obstacles and challenges that will test their skills and reflexes. The game's controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy for young players to navigate and play. Overall, Funny Nose Surgery is a unique and engaging game that is sure to captivate young players. With its colorful graphics, simple controls, and educational value, this game is a must-play for children aged 4-8. So, if you're looking for a game that is both fun and educational, Funny Nose Surgery is the perfect choice for you and your kids.
